spec_points.text: Candidates answer on one set text in Section A (Poetry).
From Songs of Ourselves Volume 1 , Part 4, the following 15 poems:
Thom Gunn, ‘The Man with Night Sweats’
Anne Stevenson, ‘The Spirit is too Blunt an Instrument’
Charles Tennyson Turner, ‘On Finding a Small Fly Crushed in a Book’
These may be found in Songs of Ourselves Volume 1: The University of Cambridge International printed in this text.
From Songs of Ourselves Volume 2 , Part 4, the following 15 poems:
Sir Thomas Wyatt, ‘I Find No Peace’
Mary Monck (‘Marinda’), ‘Verses Written on Her Death-bed at Bath to Her Husband in London’
A R D Fairburn, ‘Rhyme of the Dead Self’
Percy Bysshe Shelley, ‘Stanzas Written in Dejection, Near Naples’
Elinor Morton Wylie, ‘Now Let No Charitable Hope’
Alexander Pope, ‘From An Essay on Criticism’
Henry Wotton, ‘The Character of a Happy Life’
These may be found in Songs of Ourselves Volume 2: The University of Cambridge International printed in this text.
Snowdrop in the paper will be printed as in this text.
Candidates answer on one set text in Section B (Prose).
Joan Lindsay Picnic at Hanging Rock

From Stories of Ourselves Volume 2 , the following 10 stories: no. 2 Nathaniel Hawthorne, ‘Dr Heidegger’s Experiment’ no. 16 O Henry, ‘The Furnished Room’ no. 18 Charlotte Perkins Gilman, ‘The Widow’s Might’ no. 25 Henry Handel Richardson, ‘And Women Must Weep’ no. 29 Marghanita Laski, ‘The Tower’ no. 31 Janet Frame, ‘The Reservoir’ no. 32 Langston Hughes, ‘Thank You M’am’ no. 41 Anjana Appachana, ‘Sharmaji’ no. 43 Yiyun Li, ‘A Thousand Years of Good Prayers’ no. 44 Segun Afolabi, ‘Mrs Mahmood’ stories in the paper will be printed as in this text.
